locations.note: An older Ezio searches Ottoman Constantinople for the keys to Altair's sealed library.
A substantial underground-city sequence takes place in Cappadocia.
The Galata Tower is one of the landmarks Ezio can renovate and climb.
Hagia Sophia hides one of the tombs Ezio explores.
The Topkapı Palace is a renovatable landmark on the Constantinople skyline.
Ezio starts and ends at Altaïr's old stronghold, opening the sealed library with the five keys.

routes.name: Ezio and Altaïr's library
routes.note: Masyaf, the years in Constantinople with the run into Cappadocia, and back to the library.
